title: Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner
text:
I eat breakfast at seven o'clock. I like bread, eggs, and milk. Sometimes I have fruit too. My breakfast is small but good.

At lunch, I eat rice and chicken at school. My friend eats a sandwich. At dinner, my family eats soup together. We talk about our day.

questions.text: What does the narrator like to eat for breakfast?
What does the narrator eat at lunch?
What does the family probably do together at dinner?
What can we tell about the narrator's day?
options: The narrator is at school at lunchtime.
The narrator is at home at lunchtime.
The narrator is at work at lunchtime.
The narrator is at a restaurant at lunchtime.

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
the meal eaten in the middle of the day
the main meal of the day, eaten in the evening
a hot liquid food made with vegetables, meat, or other ingredients

paragraph_translations: Desayuno a las siete en punto. Me gusta el pan, los huevos y la leche. A veces también como fruta. Mi desayuno es pequeño, pero bueno.
A la hora del almuerzo, como arroz y pollo en la escuela. Mi amigo come un sándwich. En la cena, mi familia come sopa juntos. Hablamos de nuestro día.
